Comment: The intended logic is very complicated and would be difficult for someone to execute within 5 minutes. However, there is an easy way to dodge all the logic which makes this puzzle extremely easy. I think that makes this great for Coc, as there are multiple solutions of different difficulty and level of obviousness.

Basically, you just have to output the reversed input, except for the last input. The last input should be 1 if there are an odd number of 1s before it, and 0 if there are an even number.

For instance, in python:
# Take all input into a list
n = int(input())
l=[]
for i in range(n):
    l.append(int(input()))

c = l[:-1].count(1) # Count of the 1s in all of l except the last element
a = l[::-1] # Set a new list to reverse of l
a[0] = c%2 # Replace the first element with 1 if count is odd, and 0 if count is even

print(*a)

Constraints

Cases

  • Validator 4

  • The final prisoner's hat is black and they guess white.

  • The final prisoner's hat is white and they guess black.
